thread:
Ellen: Cobalt (enterprise) asked for a POC runbook + capacity numbers. They expect 100qps steady, 350qps 3-5m bursts, ~350M tokens/day. Need SSO and KMS confirmed before start.
Ravi: For 100qps steady, recommend reserved 2 GPUs. For 350qps bursts, plan burst to +4 GPUs. Offer a commit tier: 2 reserved vs 4 reserved with tiered discount.
Sam: Ops: suggest preheat to warm KV cache across all GPUs. Preheat job: 30 concurrent sessions per GPU for 8m. Autoscale policy: scale up when queue > 120 for 45s, scale down after 8m idle.
Priya: Compliance: customer requires SAML SSO and BYOK KMS in same region. I'll ask security to confirm SAML onboarding SLA (target 3 business days with metadata now). Also starting DPA paperwork.
Ellen: Pricing ask: what discount if they prepay 6 months? Sales wants a clear number.
Ravi: Tentative pricing: 15% off reserved hours for 6mo, 25% for 12mo. If they reserve 4 GPUs get extra 5% on burst credits. I'll lock numbers with finance.
Sam: Add fallback: quantized model for burst, but require canary + auto-fallback if quality delta > 2% on their eval set. Also include telemetry hooks for p50/p95 and token cost.
Priya: Blocker: SSO is hard stop. If IdP metadata isn't provided, we delay POC. I'll send the onboarding checklist to Cobalt now.
Ellen: Action items: (1) Ravi confirm final pricing, (2) Priya push SAML intake, (3) Sam prepare k6 preheat script and staging job, (4) I'll schedule presales sync after SAML.
deploy-bot: Preheat job scheduled on staging 2025-11-20T20:00:00Z. Owner: @sam.
Ellen: Thanks team. Marking pending until SSO and finance numbers are in.
